Humans have 23 pairs of chromosomes for a totally of 46. Each pair comprises one from your father and one from your mother.

Each chromosome contains many genes. Most genes have several variants. Pick a chromosome. Pick a gene. Compare the variant of the gene that you got from your father with the variant that you got from your mother. If they are the same you are homozygous for that gene. If they are different you are heterozygous for that gene.

Since there are lots of genes you can keep count. How many homozygous? How many heterozygous? "Heterozygosity" is a way of reporting the count.
